diff_cmd.description: Path to the diff utility to use for generating diffs.

diff_opts.description: String of options to pass to the diff utility.

ignore_fuzzy.description: If true, fuzzy translations are ignored during comparison.

keep_comments.description: If true, user comments are preserved in the output.

git_l_option.description: If true, enables support for the -L option for Git integration.

output_width.description: Maximum width of the output in columns. 0 means no limit.
